claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: The witness report notes that manufacturer part numbers or stamps are not shown.
The witness observed the lens and did not report any cracks, though the rear housing remains unseen.
The witness explicitly stated the condition of mounting brackets and tabs on the rear was not shown.

claims.claim: All Hyundai and kia genuine spare parts... available.
claims.evidence: This is a general business claim and contradicts the specific claim that this item is a Toyota part.

risks.risk: The electrical components (LED strip, projector, bulbs) may be dead or shorted.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the unit connected to a 12V power source with all lights functioning.

risks.risk: Mounting brackets may be snapped or glued back on, making installation impossible.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back and sides of the plastic housing showing all tabs.

risks.risk: The part may be an aftermarket 'China copy' despite the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the molded manufacturer logo (Toyota/Koito) and part number on the housing.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear of the headlight showing all mounting brackets and electrical pins.
Close-up photo of the manufacturer's stamp and part number on the plastic housing.
Video of the LED strip and main bulbs powered on.
response.reason: The seller provides conflicting brand information (Hyundai/Kia vs Toyota) and the witness cannot identify the specific vehicle model or part number required to establish a baseline value.
